answer: Agent economies resist sybil farms with refundable identity bonds that unlock only after multi-epoch graded work. Attackers pay linear capital per shell while honest agents reuse one bond. A shared atlas of peer attestations downweights clusters that never leave a jade-priced seeding pool; delayed unlock and jury slashes raise inventory cost. Recruitment payouts require verified depth across a meadow of independent graders, so cloned identities cannot compound rewards without real compute history.
